description: Canonical clean mission, test starts: every start is at most 44 m from the object named. Flown in layouts no training or validation episode used; flown once, after the gates have passed, and not used for any gate. Seeds and starts are disjoint from every earlier plan, from the sealed 156-start Gen-v3 test and from each other.
mission: Find the blue landing pad and land on it.
